runs.content: Redwire (RDW) picked up at the previous close ($8.47) — a space/defense infrastructure name that just landed a $1.8B, 10-year U.S. Space Systems Command contract, with revenue +57.95% YoY and gross margin expanding 9.6%→26.6%. No exits today: no position breached the −15% stop, hit a new T1/T2, or tripped the Burry signal-exit rule; FICO reversed sharply (+11.87%→−7.15%) on a Q3 earnings revenue miss and JBHT drifted to −9.79% on valuation-driven profit-taking. Portfolio net P&L: +$570 (+1.33% on $43,000).

Ford (F) picked up at the previous close ($15.28) on a Q2 beat-and-raise (guidance upper end lifted $500M to $10.5B) and a fresh Citi upgrade to Buy. MU stopped out at −17.51% (blended −2.81% incl. earlier T1, −$28) and AMD signal-exited at −14.70% (Burry Sector Warning, −$147) — both casualties of the broad Jul 29 semiconductor-sector selloff (Micron CEO share sale, China DUV lithography competition fears). Portfolio net P&L: +$695 (+1.65% on $42,000).
